notes: §2002:13.16.38.4 GR7 applied to record entries under an OUTPUT CD (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9): Zero with all-Z gives all spaces (ZZZ.ZZ: six spaces; ZZ/ZZ: five, the embedded "/" included), zero with all-* gives "***.**" (decimal separator kept), leading-Z form a keeps the fraction ("   .00"); nonzero: "  1.50", "**1.50", and ZZ/ZZ with 12 suppresses the "/" before the first nonzero digit ("   12"). The --std 2002 run of the pinned build (dc1f2dcce8) matched the derived .out.
